messages:
Maya: Heads-up everyone 1: Pastel Ridge case study prep. Interview scheduled Tue 10:00 PT. Need: 1) final customer quote approved, 2) short social clip (30s) + cleaned transcript, 3) hero stat for the long-form post, 4) webinar signup routing + SFDC campaign. Can we split?

Owen: I'll take copy and the long-form post. Assigning social clip + transcript cleanup to Rae. Priya can handle quote/legal. Sam, can you handle SFDC campaign and registrant routing?

Sam (Sales Ops): Yep. Plan: campaign = PR_Case_May2026, AE assignment = mid-market team. Will push registrants to campaign and tag source=webinar_pastelridge. Any special segmentation?

Maya: Add a flag for anyone who downloads the benchmark PDF -> tag `benchmark_engaged`. Also we want UTM params: utm_campaign=pastelridge_case.

Rae: Need the raw interview file + suggested timestamps. Can someone drop link? And confirm redaction rules (model names ok to keep or remove)?

Maya: Raw: https://files.redwood/pastelridge/interview_2026-05-03.mp4. Suggest highlight 00:07:10-00:07:40 where CTO calls out latency. Redact proprietary model identifiers; customer is comfortable with numbers and high-level product descriptors only.

Owen: Draft quote idea: "Redwood made our inferencing 3x faster and cut cost-per-inference by over 40%" 1CTO, Pastel Ridge

Priya (Legal): That language is aggressive. Need backup data and a signed release. If bench CSV + methodology are attached we can approve exact phrasing. Otherwise recommend conservative text: "we saw over 40% lower inference costs and significantly faster p95 latency". I'll queue the release template to the customer.

release-bot: Reminder: signed_release_missing. Please upload `pastelridge_case_release_signed.pdf` to complete legal checklist.

Eli: I'm pulling the benchmark artifacts now. Running `pr-bench-2026-trial4`. Will upload CSV and a short note on how p95 was computed. ETA 2 hours.

Priya (Legal): Once Eli uploads the CSV + methodology I'll review and aim to approve the exact quote. Also confirm we have written permission to use logo and customer name.

Rae: Got the raw. Will prep a 30s clip + 60s cut for Linkedin. For transcript redaction: remove exact model names and any internal pipeline references. Keep the line that mentions the 0.6s p95 and percent cost drop.

Sam (Sales Ops): SFDC campaign created: ID = 7012A3. Zapier flow will push registrants to that campaign. Adding conditional tag `benchmark_engaged` if `pdf_downloaded=true` within 48h. I'll post the Zap config in #sales-ops when finished.

Maya: Timing plan: webinar Thu 11am PT. Publish long-form case study + benchmark summary same day after webinar. Short social clips go live during webinar. Legal-approved assets only.

Owen: I'll leave placeholders in the draft for hero stat and quote until Eli uploads. Also prepping a short pull-quote card for social.

Eli: Uploaded `pr-bench-trial4-results.csv` to `benchmarks/pastelridge/`. Methodology note: test traffic simulated with 1k inferences, batch sizes matched production 8-16, p95 measured over 1k requests. Cost run includes GPU + infra amortized. Numbers: cost down 41.2%, p95 0.59s from 1.9s.

Priya (Legal): Received files. Approving numbers + quote as Owen drafted but suggest we tighten to: "cut inference costs by ~41% and reduced p95 latency to ~0.6s" 1CTO, Pastel Ridge. Also still need signed release and logo permissions file.

Rae: I'll export the clips and upload redacted transcript by EOD tomorrow. Will attach the social cut + timestamps here.

Sam (Sales Ops): Zap live, campaign syncing. Will validate a test registration tonight.

Maya: Nice. Quick recaps: Owen (copy + publish), Priya (legal sign-off + release), Rae (clips + transcript), Eli (benchmark artifacts uploaded), Sam (SFDC + routing). If signed release comes in, we publish per plan.

Owen: Thanks. Will ping again once copy is ready for review.

Priya (Legal): Once release PDF is attached here I'll mark legal checklist completed.

Maya: Closing loop for now. We'll reconvene after the interview and before publish. :rocket:
